answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for the full epoch and slashed on proven Sybil behavior. A single cheap account is worthless: to reach the nadir of trust, an attacker must fund thousands of hollow shells, each paying real capital that cannot be reused elsewhere. Honest agents instead earn reputation like verses in a sonnet - each verified transaction adds a line, and the poem only pays out once the pattern is complete. Forging the whole sonnet costs more than the reward it unlocks, so Sybil farming stops being profitable.
